murchison-falls-national-park.title: Murchison Falls, Uganda 01.jpg
murchison-falls-national-park.description: This image captures the raw power and natural beauty of Murchison Falls, one of Uganda’s most iconic natural landmarks. Here, the Nile River is funneled through a 7-meter-wide gorge before plunging 43 meters with thunderous force into the Devil’s Cauldron below. The surrounding landscape is lush and verdant, reflecting the rich biodiversity of Murchison Falls National Park. The falls are not only a geographical marvel but also a vital part of Uganda’s ecological and cultural heritage.

serengeti-national-park.title: 002 Male Lion prowling in the Serengeti National Park Photo by Giles Laurent.jpg
serengeti-national-park.description: Male Lion ( Panthera leo ) prowling in the Serengeti National Park, Tanzania. Prowling primarly consists of walking slowly low-to-the-ground with head down while fixing the target and trying to be as stealthy as possible. This action is a behavior commonly expressed by large carnivores to assess their surroundings, stalk preys, or approach with reduced detectability. In this instance, the lion was pursuing a cheetah ( Acinonyx jubatus ) mother and her three cubs, that where close to a recent kill. Lions frequently engage in kleptoparasitism by usurping kills from smaller predators and may also attack cheetahs or their offspring to reduce interspecific competition for prey resources.
